This defect has a measured cost, which is why it is a recommendation and not just a note: the wrong character is why url_verifier read ALL TWELVE of this row's carried refs as system-only name matches, and why the 湖口-金砂湾-彭泽支线 lead surfaced on P4790 could not be keyed back to this row. The English transliteration is unaffected and needs no change. Orchestrator ruling; the relevance gate is one character deep on CJK place names, so this is worth a note in docs/country_notes/china.md too.

resolutions.researcher_notes: OWNER ENTITY CORRECTION — grid-wide, already staged the same way on P4791. The carried QCCOwner(业主单位) value names the 46% holder as 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司 (the PipeChina PARENT). The SSE prospectus text names it as 国家管网集团东部原油储运有限公司 (原'中国石化管道储运有限公司'), the PipeChina SUBSIDIARY, and RELAUNCH_NOTES item 2 states the same rule. Proposed on the Operator record of this shard; flagged here so the merge can apply it consistently across every Jiangxi Phase I row carrying the parent's name.

PREFECTURE-GRANULARITY INCONSISTENCY — decision owed at merge. This row had StartPrefecture/District BLANK and EndPrefecture/District = 'Jiujiang' (the prefecture-level city). Sibling row P5886 (Phase I Shenguili-Pengze Branch, the same network, the same researcher) uses COUNTY granularity in the same columns: 'Hukou County' and 'Pengze County'. Two segment-naming documents put this entire line 「位于九江市湖口县境内」 / 「项目位于九江市湖口县」, so Jinshawan is in Hukou County too and 'Jiujiang' on the End side is coarser than its siblings for the identical place. I have STAGED the blank one (StartPrefecture/District = 'Hukou County', on the Location record) because a blank is an owed unit; I have NOT overwritten the existing 'Jiujiang', because that is a house-style question about which granularity these columns take, not a factual error. If GEM wants county granularity, EndPrefecture/District becomes 'Hukou County'.

DISCOVERY / DUPLICATION GUARD — CLOSED, no missing row and no duplicate. (1) The line this segment belongs to is 湖口-金砂湾-彭泽支线; P5866 is only its 湖口-金砂湾段. The Jinshawan->Pengze continuation is NOT missing from GEM: it is row P5886 'Phase I Shenguili-Pengze Branch' (沈贵里—彭泽支线, proposed, 18.5 km, DN200, Hukou County -> Pengze County, ProposalYear 2022). The link is physical and documented: this row's 安全验收 report says 「全线改建站场1座（湖口分输站）、新建截断阀室1座（沈贵里阀室）」, and 沈贵里 valve chamber is exactly P5886's start point — so the continuation was re-scoped to start from P5866's valve chamber rather than from Jinshawan. Nothing to add as a discovery. (2) NO OVERLAP WITH THE LNG-II TIE-IN: the 2024-approved 江西省天然气管网与湖口LNG二期联通工程 (650 m / 625 m, DN300 / D323.9mm, 739.86万元) is a separate short spur that ties INTO this segment 12.5 km from the 沈贵里 valve chamber; it is not part of P5866 and none of its figures are staged here. (3) A STATION THAT WAS NEVER BUILT: both acceptance documents record that the planned 金砂湾分输站 was not built / was demolished 「新建的金砂湾分输站因政策原因已拆除，现场恢复原貌」, the line depending instead on the rebuilt 湖口分输站 — relevant if any GEM row or future discovery treats a Jinshawan metering/distribution station as existing infrastructure.

Carried v2 __STATUS__ verdict CONFIRM stands, now on a wider evidence base (status_review_owed is False for this row, so this is a carry-forward, not a new required verdict). Status = operating: built 2017-12 -> 2021-01, commissioned and flowing gas by the July 2021 环保验收公示, statutorily safety-accepted 2023-02, and treated as 「已建」 existing pipe by the 省能源局 in April 2024 and by the 2025 LNG-II safety report, whose text describes its 沈贵里 valve chamber telemetering live to the provincial dispatch centre. No evidence of shutdown, mothballing or reversal was found.

cross_row_leads.facts: 《江西省天然气管网一期工程湖口-金砂湾-彭泽支线（湖口-金砂湾段）》安全验收公示 (jxganan.com, 2023-02-17) states 「全线改建站场1座（湖口分输站）、新建截断阀室1座（沈贵里阀室），新建的金砂湾分输站因政策原因已拆除，现场恢复原貌」. The 沈贵里阀室 built as part of P5866 is P5886's START POINT — which explains why P5886 is named 沈贵里—彭泽支线 rather than 金砂湾—彭泽: the planned 金砂湾分输站 was cancelled and demolished, so the continuation was re-scoped to start from P5866's valve chamber. Also relevant to P5886: the 2014 provincial DRC plan (《江西省天然气利用规划（2013-2020年）》赣发改规划〔2014〕325号) schedules the WHOLE 湖口—金砂湾—彭泽 line at 23 km, of which P5866 is 19.12 km — consistent with P5886's recorded 18.5 km only if the re-scoped 沈贵里 origin is taken into account, so do NOT treat 23 km as an upper bound on P5886. And the operator/phase: P5886 is the same Phase I network under 江西省天然气管道有限公司.

《江西省天然气管网与湖口LNG二期联通工程项目安全验收评价报告（终稿）》GAAP[2025]0054号 (jxganan.com uploads, 2025-03-14) describes 沈贵里阀室 in operational detail: 「沈贵里阀室为江西省天然气管网一期工程金砂湾支线干线截断阀室，介于湖口站和湖口LNG二期工程之间…阀室具备线路截断、放空及分输预留功能」 — note 分输预留 (a reserved offtake), i.e. the physical provision for P5886's branch. It also lists the 九江作业区's stations and valve chambers: 「共包括九江、庐山、沙河、湖口、蔡岭、都昌6个分输站，海会、白鹿、华林、金湖、宝塔、莲花、新港、双钟、武山、蔡岭、沈贵里、茶铺12个阀室，共青城、星子、金砂湾、彭泽4个计量站」 (约259.7km of line in that operating area) — a useful station/valve inventory for every Jiujiang-area Jiangxi Phase I row, and note that 金砂湾 and 彭泽 appear as 计量站 (metering stations).

江西省能源局《关于江西省天然气管网与湖口LNG二期联通工程项目核准的批复》(drc.jiangxi.gov.cn, 核准 2024-04-14, 发布 2024-04-18) — a provincial REGULATOR document, addressed to 省投资集团有限公司, citing 九发改油气字〔2024〕164号 and 赣府厅发〔2017〕35号. Two facts useful to the Phase I network parent row: (a) it states 「项目单位为：江西省天然气管道有限公司。」, confirming that company as the Phase I network operator in a government source rather than only in credit reports; (b) it names 江西省天然气管网一期工程湖口-金砂湾-彭泽支线（湖口-金砂湾段） verbatim, so drc.jiangxi.gov.cn's col14665 approvals collection is a live, indexable source of segment-NAMING government documents for this whole grid — worth crawling for other Jiangxi rows still stuck on system-level refs. Its own project figures (650m, DN300, 6.3MPa, 739.86万元) are the LNG-II spur's, an AGGREGATE-class trap for anyone tempted to stage them on a network row.
